parName: # vol is the volumes, as exogenously read, in one specific class [Mm^3]
# betaCoef is the Volume gain ratio from previous diameter class to the current one
# tp is the time of passage [years] from a diameter class to go to the next one.
# vReg is the (exogenous) regeneration for the first class [Mm^3]
# entryVolHa(i,essence,lambda) initial density at the beginning of the first diameter class, when trees reach 7.5 cm [m^3/ha].
# finalHarvestFlag determines if a harvest have to be considered thinning (0) or final harvest (1). Final harvests free area.
# tCV is the temporal coefficient of cvariation in volume productivity. From IFN 2005-2012 using the python script
# tStDev is the temporal standard deviation in volume productivity. From IFN 2005-2012 using the python script

# mortCoef is the (yearly !) mortality coefficient within a given class. Updated 20131206 with IFN data 2005-2012 by region, species and – just graphic – size of trees. Source: http://inventaire-forestier.ign.fr/spip/IMG/pdf/mortalite-2.pdf
# agr is the average volume growth rate. Replaced the old value taken from IFN 2005-2012 using the python script with the new one computed by LERFOB
# freq is the frequence of each sp. group in the region. It is not normalised for  SUM(freq) < 1, only for SUM(freq) > 1
# freq_norm is the normalised frequency by sp. group, with SUM(freq) = 1
# tp_multiplier is the modifier of the time of passage. NOT YET KNOW IF IT IS DIRECTLY OF THE TIME OF PASSAGE OR OF THE PRODUCTIVITY (1/tp)
# sStDev is the spatial standard deviation in volume productivity. Replaced the old one using the python script from IFN 2005-2012 with the new one computed from LerFob data
# mortCoef_multiplier is the modifier of mortality coefficient.
# betaCoef_multiplier is the modifier of the beta coefficient (trees form factor)
# forOperEmissions – Kg of CO2 emitted per cubic meter of forest operations
